title: 常见语法错误
goal: 能在保留邮件原意的前提下改正六类常见语法和书写错误。
exam: TOEFL iBT（2026 年 1 月起的新版）· 写作

points.label: 改正时态和主谓一致的错误
改正冠词、介词和标点的错误

sources.title: ETS：Writing Scoring Guide — Write an Email
sources.used: 0–5 分每一档的描述（本课是中文转述，原文以官方为准）

body.p: 改语法错误时，邮件的事实和意图不能变。时态表示动作发生的时间。主谓一致看主语的中心词。冠词、介词和标点决定名词之间的关系，以及句子在哪里结束。

body.box:
The list of names is attached.
The names on the list are correct.

body.p: 第一句的主语中心词是 list，不是 names；第二句的主语是 names。动词的单复数看中心词，不看离动词最近的名词。不完整的句子要补出主句，只改词尾不够。

cards.title: 常见错误：基本形式
rows: 时态
I send the invitation yesterday.
I sent the invitation yesterday.
yesterday 是已经过去的时间，用过去式。
主谓一致
The list of applicants are attached.
The list of applicants is attached.
中心词 list 是单数，动词用 is。
冠词
I need a advice about the form.
I need advice about the form.
advice 不可数，不加 a。要计数时说 a piece of advice。
介词
Please reply me by Monday.
Please reply to me by Monday.
reply 后面接人要加 to。by Monday 表示周一之前。
标点和大小写
the room is locked, I cannot enter.
The room is locked. I cannot enter.
两个完整的句子不能只用逗号连接。句首字母大写。
句子不完整
Because the attachment is missing.
Because the attachment is missing, I cannot check the details.
because 从句不能单独成句，要接上主句。

cards.title: 常见错误：语境限定
rows: 时态
I have received the badge last Friday.
I received the badge last Friday.
有 last Friday 这类过去时间，用一般过去时，不用现在完成时。
主谓一致
The replacement keys is ready.
The replacement keys are ready.
中心词 keys 是复数，replacement 只是修饰语。
冠词
Could you send me an copy of the receipt?
Could you send me a copy of the receipt?
a 和 an 看后一个词的读音。copy 以辅音开头，用 a。
介词
The interview is in Tuesday.
The interview is on Tuesday.
具体某天用 on；月份用 in，如 in May。
标点和大小写
i can attend on monday.
I can attend on Monday.
代词 I 和星期名大写。普通名词不大写。
句子不完整
The parcel that arrived this morning.
The parcel that arrived this morning contains the samples.
that arrived 只修饰 parcel，句子还缺谓语 contains。

body.box:
Context: Yesterday, a student received a box containing two damaged microscope slides. The student is reporting the damage now.
Draft: Dear Laboratory Supplier,
i receive the box yesterday. The slides in the box is damaged. Because the glass is cracked.
Best regards,
Nadia

body.p: 有 yesterday，receive 改为 received。主语是 slides，is 改为 are。Because the glass is cracked 只有原因，要补出它造成的影响。

body.box:
Dear Laboratory Supplier,
I received the box yesterday. The slides in the box are damaged. Because the glass is cracked, I cannot use them for the demonstration.
Best regards,
Nadia

body.p: received 说的是已经收到，are 说的是现在的状态，两句时态不同是正常的。I 和句首字母大写。补主句时保留 cracked 这一事实，不编造已有的处理结果。

groups.text:
Context: The ticket office issued a replacement yesterday. The message reports that single completed event.
Draft: Dear Ticket Office, I collect the replacement yesterday.

items.stem: Which revision preserves the event and its time?
options: I collected the replacement yesterday.
I have collected the replacement yesterday.
I was collecting the replacement yesterday.
I collected the replacements yesterday.
items.why: single completed event 和 yesterday 表示过去完成的一次动作，用一般过去时 collected，即第一项。第二项的现在完成时不能与 yesterday 连用。

groups.text:
Context: One envelope contains several completed forms and is attached to the message as a scanned file.
Draft: The envelope containing the forms are attached.

items.stem: Which revision corrects agreement while preserving the attached object and its contents?
options: The envelopes containing the forms are attached.
The envelope containing the forms is attached.
The forms from the envelope are attached.
The envelope containing the form is attached.
items.why: The envelope containing the forms 的主语中心词是 envelope，containing the forms 只是修饰，谓语应为 is。

groups.text:
Context: A student requests guidance, without specifying a particular recommendation.
Draft: Dear Careers Team, Could you give me an advice about the interview?

items.stem: Which revision preserves the general request and corrects the noun phrase?
options: Could you give the interviewer advice about my application?
Could you arrange an interview about the advice I provided?
Could you give me advice about the interview?
Could you explain the recommendation I have already received?
items.why: without specifying a particular recommendation 说明请求的是一般的指导。advice 不可数，去掉 an，即第三项。

groups.text:
Context: The message announces a briefing on a specific day.
Draft: The briefing will take place in Friday.

items.stem: Which correction preserves the intended day?
options: The briefing will take place before Friday.
The briefing will take place after Friday.
The briefing will take place by Friday.
The briefing will take place on Friday.
items.why: specific day 指星期五当天，具体某天用 on，即第四项。第三项的 by 表示截止，改变了时间。

groups.text:
Context: The sender cannot unlock a cabinet and needs the key.
Draft: The cabinet is locked, I need the key.

items.stem: Which revision fixes the sentence boundary while preserving the stated situation?
options: The cabinet is unlocked. I need the key.
The cabinet is locked because I need the key.
The cabinet is locked. I need the key.
I have the key; it is locked.
items.why: The cabinet is locked 和 I need the key 都是完整的句子，用句号分开，即第三项。第二项的 because 把需要钥匙写成了上锁的原因。

groups.text:
Context: The missing page prevents a reviewer from checking the total.
Draft: Because the last page is missing.

items.stem: Which completion supplies the missing main clause without changing the situation?
options: the reviewer cannot verify the total.
the reviewer can verify the total without it.
the reviewer has already verified the total.
the reviewer can still verify it.
items.why: prevents a reviewer from checking the total 说明结果是无法核对。第一项补出了这个主句。

items.stem: A courier is identifying the contents of a newly arrived package.
items.why: that arrived this morning 修饰 package，contains 是主句的谓语。containing 不能单独作谓语。

items.stem: A student confirms availability on a weekday.
items.why: can 后面接原形 attend。具体某天用 on，Monday 大写。

groups.text:
Context: The bursar sent a refund yesterday, and the student confirms that completed transfer now.
Draft: Dear Bursar, I receive the refund yesterday. Thank you for processing it.

items.stem: Which revision preserves the time of receipt?
options: I received the refund yesterday.
I have received the refund yesterday.
I was receiving the refund yesterday.
I received the refunds yesterday.
items.why: yesterday 和 completed transfer 表示过去已完成的事，用一般过去时 received，即第一项。第二项的现在完成时不能与 yesterday 连用。

groups.text:
Context: A single schedule lists all appointments and accompanies the email as a file.
Draft: Dear Adviser, The schedule of appointments are attached.

items.stem: Which change corrects agreement without changing the facts?
options: Make schedule plural to match are.
Change are to is to match schedule.
Change appointments to appointment to match schedule.
Change attached to attaching to match appointments.
items.why: a single schedule 说明只有一份日程。中心词 schedule 是单数，are 改为 is，即第二项。

groups.text:
Context: The writer wants one unspecified hour to prepare a demonstration.
Draft: Dear Demonstration Coordinator, I need a hour to prepare the equipment.

items.stem: Which revision corrects the article without changing the preparation request?
options: I need the hour we reserved to prepare the equipment.
I need an hour each day to prepare the equipment.
I need an hour to prepare the equipment.
I need hours to prepare the equipment.
items.why: one unspecified hour 要用不定冠词。hour 以元音开头，用 an hour，即第三项。第二项多出了 each day。

groups.text:
Context: A rehearsal takes place on the day named in the message.
Draft: Dear Stage Team, The rehearsal is in Wednesday.

items.stem: Which correction preserves the stated timing?
options: The rehearsal is before Wednesday.
The rehearsal is after Wednesday.
The rehearsal is by Wednesday.
The rehearsal is on Wednesday.
items.why: on the day named 指星期三当天，用 on Wednesday，即第四项。第三项的 by 表示截止，改变了时间。

items.stem: The writer reports a delivery completed last night.
items.why: last night 是已经过去的时间，用 received。

items.stem: Two boxes contain spare cables and are ready for collection now.
items.lead: The boxes containing the spare cables
items.why: 主语 boxes 为复数，containing the spare cables 是修饰成分，谓语用 are。

items.stem: The office asks which day the sender can discuss a corrected invoice.
items.why: available for a discussion 表示可参加讨论，具体星期前用 on。

items.stem: A torn page prevents the sender from reading the final instruction.
items.why: Because 从句之后，逗号后补出主句 I cannot read the final instruction。cannot 后面用原形 read。
